t: You are looking at the Shepherd's Bush Empire, now a music venue, run by the Academy Music Group. It was built in 1903 as a music hall for the impresario Oswald Stoll, and Charlie Chaplin was among its early performers. In 1953 it became the BBC Television Theatre, and it has been a music venue since 1994. The building is Grade II listed. Its architect was Frank Matcham, who designed theatres and music halls across the country. He also designed the Hackney Empire, the Coliseum and the Palladium.
